title: Graphic sequences: the Erdős–Gallai and Havel–Hakimi theorems
summary: A Lean 4 / Mathlib formalization of the two classical characterizations of degree sequences of finite simple graphs: the Erdős–Gallai theorem (a non-increasing sequence is graphic if and only if its sum is even and every initial segment satisfies the Erdős–Gallai inequality) and the Havel–Hakimi theorem (a non-increasing sequence is graphic if and only if its first term is at most the number of remaining terms, the next d₀ terms are positive, and the reduced sequence is graphic).
